title: FlyWheel: Attention Kernels Built for the TPU
abstract: arXiv:2611.01426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attention kernels on Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) often underutilize their matrix units (MXUs) because of repeated matrix operand loads, vector-intensive computation, and dependencies that leave MXUs idle. We present FlyWheel, a set of fast TPU kernels for both softmax and linear attention. FlyWheel reformulates softmax and triangular inversion to reduce vector work, while coordinating data layouts to improve matrix operand reuse. It then overlaps independent computation to hide execution latency. We apply these techniques to both softmax attention and Gated DeltaNet on TPU v6e and v7x. FlyWheel speeds up softmax attention by up to $4.14\times$ over the state-of-the-art RPA kernel and $1.80\times$ over Splash Attention, reaching 81% of peak BF16 throughput on v6e. translated_title: FlyWheel：专为TPU打造的注意力内核
translated_abstract: 张量处理单元（TPU）上的注意力内核常常因为重复的矩阵操作数加载、向量密集型计算以及导致矩阵单元（MXU）闲置的依赖关系而无法充分利用其矩阵单元。我们提出了FlyWheel，这是一组面向softmax注意力和线性注意力的快速TPU内核。FlyWheel重新表述了softmax和三角矩阵求逆以减少向量计算工作，同时协调数据布局以提高矩阵操作数的复用率，进而通过重叠相互独立的计算来隐藏执行延迟。我们将这些技术应用于TPU v6e和v7x上的softmax注意力和Gated DeltaNet。FlyWheel将softmax注意力的速度相比最先进的RPA内核提升最高4.14倍，相比Splash Attention提升最高1.80倍，在v6e上达到峰值BF16吞吐量的81%。它还将Gated DeltaNet的预填充（prefill）速度提升最高3.61倍。集成到为Qwen3.8-27B提供服务的vLLM中后，FlyWheel将预填充吞吐量提升最高1.56倍，同时保持……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FlyWheel是一组专为TPU设计的快速注意力内核，通过重新表述softmax与三角矩阵求逆以减少向量计算、协调数据布局提升矩阵操作数复用并重叠独立计算，在softmax注意力上实现最高4.14倍加速并达到v6e峰值BF16吞吐量的81%，同时将Gated DeltaNet预填充加速最高3.61倍。
en_tdlr: FlyWheel is a set of fast TPU attention kernels that reformulate softmax and triangular inversion to cut vector work, improve matrix operand reuse, and overlap independent computations, achieving up to 4.14× speedup for softmax attention (reaching 81% of peak BF16 throughput on v6e) and up to 3.61× for Gated DeltaNet prefill.
